costume.name: Starlight Witch

pieces.name: Pointed witch hat

pieces.styleNotes: A dark pointed hat anchors the witch silhouette. Options vary from black velvet to blue velvet or black star embroidery; none exactly matches the reference silver-on-navy hat.

matches.reason: Blue velvet wide-brim pointed hat; blue is brighter than midnight navy and has no silver embroidery. Only the hat is included.
